analyst.summary: Texmaco Rail makes railway wagons and rail infrastructure equipment almost entirely for Indian Railways-linked demand, and after an exceptional FY25, the business has turned down sharply - the most recent quarter's revenue and profit are both meaningfully lower than a year ago, reflecting a genuine slowdown in railway orders and project execution rather than a one-off item. Returns on capital are weak, the promoter's shareholding has declined by roughly ten percentage points over the past few years without a clear explanation available to us, and the stock has already fallen sharply. We are keeping this at Hold per the quant score, but flagging it clearly for the desk given how weak several fundamental readings are together.
